{{Top|canon=B-wing heavy assault starfighter}}
{{MoreSources}}
The '''B-wing starfighter''' was a type of [[Heavy assault starfighter/Legends|heavy assault starfighter]]. Models included the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]]<ref name="B-wing DB">{{DB|starship|bwingstarfighter|B-wing starfighter}}</ref> and the [[B-wing/E starfighter]].<ref name="Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}
